Command: Honour All People; Love the Brotherhood; Fear God
Summary: Peter's honour command: honour all men, love the brotherhood, fear God, honour the king.
Commandment: Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.
Application: Distinct from the submission-to-authorities row (live), which governs obedience to rulers: this governs honour itself — universal to all people, special to the brotherhood, reverent to God, and due even to the king.
Purpose: TRADITIONAL reading: to order honour rightly — wide to all, deep to the church, highest to God.
